located_point.method: Not located in imagery. Indian Archaeology 1987-88 (PDF page 25, item 35) gives the ancient site, locally known as Bibino Timbo, as 'Lat 22 deg 54' 40" N; Long 70 deg 37' 30" E', 3 km south-east of the present village. That point lies about 0.9 km east of the held 5 km window, which is centred on the village (the site index point). A render of the window's south-east corner shows fields, a canal and a river bend; the roughly 90 m square double fortification could not be recognised.

sources.imagery_result: no lines: the window is centred on the modern village and the printed site coordinate falls just outside it; no Harappan feature was identified

notes: The plan library holds no Kuntasi plan. Dhavalikar (printed page 37, PDF page 52) is one page of text without a plan. The held Indian Archaeology volumes for 1987-88, 1988-89 and 1989-90 describe the excavation in text only. A repeat needs the Kuntasi monograph (Dhavalikar, Raval and Chitalwala 1996) and imagery shifted about 3 km east.
